groove.chordVoicingEvidence: Even bars: F# bass and A3/C#4/F#4; odd bars: B bass and A3/C#4/E4. A/B is a measured slash chord (B9sus4 without third), not B major or B minor inferred from the root.
groove.keyEvidence: A3 fundamental at ~220Hz is much stronger than A#; initial global profile F# major was biased by bass overtones. YIN F#1/B1 fundamentals (strongest spectral partials F#2/B2) and harmonic peaks support F# minor.
groove.gridNote: BPM refined from kick timing in the stable source section. Eight-bar sample count rounded to the nearest complete AAC frame (1024 samples); rendered BPM remains within 0.5 of both measurements. This avoids trailing AAC padding in every persistent loop. Short FX/riser use presentation duration.

tempoMethodForHarmonicLoops: Same measured source transport and exact8bar duration; first-bar acoustic attack checks. A slowly sustained pad has no independently identifiable quarter-note tempo.

unpitchedEffects.method: Acoustic unpitched-noise screen: no strong periodic fundamental and no dominant narrow spectral line. Does not substitute for user timbre approval.
